cases.case_label: Alu in exon 7 of CASR (Nova Scotia)
cases.disease: Neonatal severe hyperparathyroidism (homozygous) / familial hypocalciuric hypercalcemia (heterozygous)
cases.mechanism_detail: An insertion containing an Alu element with an exceptionally long polyA tract in CASR exon 7 is described as inactivating; homozygotes have NSHPT and heterozygotes FHH. Molecular consequence beyond inactivation not described in the abstract.
cases.quote: we found homoallelic homozygosity for an insertion mutation in exon 7 of CASR that includes an Alu repeat element with an exceptionally long polyA tract.
